headline: Union Cabinet Proposes 50 Percent Lok Sabha Seat Increase By 2051
seoTitle: Union Cabinet Proposes 50 Percent Lok Sabha Seat Increase
metaDescription: The Union Cabinet approved a bill to expand Lok Sabha seats by 50 percent, freeze delimitation until 2051, and mandate 33 percent reservation for women.
aiSummaryBullets: The Union Cabinet approved legislation to expand Lok Sabha seats from 550 to 850.
A new bill mandates a 33 percent reservation for women in Lok Sabha and state assemblies beginning in 2029.
Constitutional amendments propose a uniform 50 percent increase in constituencies for all states based on the 2011 Census.
aiContextParagraph: The Union Cabinet has introduced a significant legislative package aimed at restructuring India's lower house of parliament. The proposed Constitutional Amendment Bill and a companion Delimitation Bill seek to increase the total number of Lok Sabha seats by 50 percent, moving from 550 to 850. A central feature of this proposal is the implementation of a 33 percent reservation quota for women, scheduled to take effect in the 2029 electoral cycle for both the Lok Sabha and state legislative bodies. The current plan involves a uniform expansion across states while implementing a freeze on delimitation processes until 2051, decoupling this electoral revision from population stabilization metrics. While government representatives and members of the ruling party have defended the initiative, some opposition figures, including P. Chidambaram, have voiced criticism regarding the strategy of applying an even 50 percent increase across all states.
whyItIsViral: The proposal has gained strong attention due to coverage by four major national outlets discussing significant changes to India's parliamentary structure.
